note: The gateway is a pure model-inference broker. It accepts only the request kinds listed here and rejects every sandbox-supplied field that could describe a tool, file, command, credential or endpoint. Provider credentials exist only in the trusted gateway process; the scored sandbox reaches the gateway through a credential-less Unix domain socket. For tasks whose frozen trusted policy grants network_allowed=true, the anthropic-messages adapter may add only the frozen Anthropic server-side web-search tool itself; the sandbox cannot select or configure tools.

prompt_caching.note: Trusted-side only and invisible to the sandbox. The adapter marks the system block and the last user block as cache breakpoints, so a sandbox-agent conversation re-reads its growing prefix at the cache-read rate instead of full price, and a server-side web-search loop re-reads the Task Packet the same way. Caching changes what a prefix costs, never what the model sees or produces. Usage reports cache_creation_input_tokens and cache_read_input_tokens separately and the cost estimate prices each at its own rate.

anthropic_transport.note: Trusted-side only and invisible to the sandbox. A request that carries no server-side tool is sent with stream=true and its server-sent events are folded back into the buffered response shape (content blocks, stop_reason, usage) before anything else sees it. A buffered request is silent on the wire for as long as the model generates; the GitHub-hosted runner drops an outbound connection after roughly four idle minutes, and the third paid run lost every packet call that generated for longer than that as RemoteDisconnected, then paid for the same generation again on each transport retry. Streaming keeps deltas and keep-alive pings flowing for the whole generation. Requests that attach the frozen web-search tool stay buffered so their pause_turn and tool_use continuations can send the provider's content blocks back verbatim; those turns are short. The ceiling max_output_tokens_ceiling is 65536 because Claude Sonnet 5 answers of up to 128k output tokens are supported and a two-metric semantic-compression packet with adaptive thinking exceeded 32768 in the third paid run.

anthropic_web_search.note: The _20260209 variant is the one Claude Sonnet 5 supports. Older models take the basic web_search_20250305 variant instead; update this together with the model. max_uses_per_request is the whole search budget of one request; the packet-only worker prompt states it so the model finishes from what it has instead of asking for more. When a turn nevertheless stops on tool_use, the adapter answers every requested client tool with an error result and lets the turn finish (refuse-and-continue), counting toward max_turn_continuations.

anthropic_decoding.note: Claude Sonnet 5 removed temperature/top_p/top_k and rejects them with HTTP 400, and runs adaptive thinking when the thinking parameter is omitted. The adapter therefore sends no sampling parameters and pins depth with output_config.effort. `effort` applies to every scored request (trial completions and packet-only workers), is identical for every language, and leaves thinking at the provider default exactly as primary.json's sampling section records. `orchestration_effort` and `orchestration_thinking` apply only to sandbox-agent action turns, which are never scored: adaptive thinking is billed inside max_tokens, and at high effort the first action turn of a unit regularly spent its entire output cap on reasoning; even at low effort roughly one action turn in twelve ended with all of its output inside the thinking block and no text, which the runtime counts as a protocol error and a lost turn. Action turns therefore run with thinking disabled. `empty_completion_retries` is how many times the adapter re-sends an identical request whose completion ended normally with no text at all before handing that empty answer to the sandbox. The sandbox selects a purpose label only; every depth is frozen here and recorded per request in the audit log.
anthropic_decoding.evaluation_effort_note: A frozen depth for every scored request of one evaluation, applied by the trusted side per task through the frozen policy (production_run.py policy writes it, the gateway reads it; the sandbox still cannot choose). Semantic Compression packets carry the whole frozen site matrix, about 180k tokens, and at high effort the model spent the entire 65,536-token output cap reasoning before writing a score: rehearsal 4 produced 1,183 characters of answer. The depth is identical for every language within the evaluation, which is what section 6.2 requires, and it is recorded in every Semantic Compression cache record's frozen_sampling and in the audit log.
